title: Exit-4 envelope: a reaching request beyond its grant (discovery revision 10; Escalation paths, T1). Printed on stdout; nothing was performed. Told apart from the confirmation envelope by status. Its command is the OPERATOR's, never the agent's

grant.description: The grant the request was checked against

name.description: The limit exceeded, e.g. ttl, ports, instances, budget, capabilities

extend.description: The operator's exact command that makes this request allowed. The agent cannot run it

request.description: The refused request, as the tool sent it

ledger_id.description: Where the authority recorded the refusal, when it records one

description: No `confirm` key: an operator's command never appears in a field the agent's habit runs (discovery revision 10). Checked by timelike-conform C9 and the agentio units, since the project's schema subset has no `not`
